column1: # <ghidra full name, or 'ns::' for a whole namespace> <TAB> <file under tree/>
# first function of the sky asm section is skyproc.s, even though it is labelled skyfunc::
# SCREAM keeps the 989 Sound core as libscream.a(989snd.ppu.o)
# sndHost_* : SCREAM host file-I/O hooks (object name inferred from the function names)
# initsky.cpp: the header and InitSky (likely PS3-only); initspace.cpp: the space-scene
# effects that follow, no header of their own. Names guesses that fit the link order.
# the sound-emitter update functions at the end of water.cpp: one update file each
# the tie drawing half of sUnk (GS presets, DrawTies): fits the link order between space and update
# mcstate.cpp: memory-card state machine between map and memcard. Its section header store
# (0x726534 = 0x10000, between map's 0x724acc and memcard's 0x72666c) is folded into MCSTATE_InitColors (was Map_InitColors).
# shadow.cpp (was rUnk): the stencil shadow volumes (DL's Shadow* functions; most of them stubbed on PS3)
# store.cpp (was sUnk): the buffer store, 64 buffers in a 4 MB pool (sorts between space and tieproc)
# global.cpp (was fUnk): Global_QuickMovieMalloc names the file; sorts between freeze and help
